author: Temminck, 1835
summary: 울창한 활엽수림이나 혼합림에 사는 녹색 비둘기로, 혼자 또는 몇 마리씩 작은 무리로 지낸다. 열매와 씨앗을 먹으며, 6월경 한배에 알 2개를 낳는다. 일본, 타이완, 인도차이나반도 등지에 분포하는 동아시아 남부 특산종이다.

points.en: dark green tail with a black band

art.subject: White-bellied Green Pigeon (Treron sieboldii), adult male: head and neck olive-green, brighter yellowish-green on the forehead and face; back, wings and tail dark green; a dark purplish-maroon patch on the shoulder (lesser and median wing coverts); flight feathers blackish-green; throat and breast yellowish-green; belly and flanks white; tail dark green with a blackish band across it; bill pale blue-grey; legs reddish-pink.
art.pose: perched in a broadleaf tree, side view, eating fruit
art.scene: dense broadleaf forest with a lush green canopy; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched among leaves: dark purplish-maroon shoulder patch, dark green back and wings, yellowish-green breast, white belly and flanks, dark green tail with a black band, pale blue-grey bill
adult female, side view perched: shoulder dark green like the rest of the wing with no purple, yellowish-green breast, white belly, black band on the dark green tail
art.build: Medium-sized, plump, rather short-necked pigeon, about 33cm, close to feral pigeon length, with a small rounded head and a medium-long tail. Bill short, much shorter than the head. Legs short. Moves slowly and quietly among leaves, clambering to reach fruit and sitting still, well hidden by its green colour. Flight fast and direct on pointed wings.
avoid: Do not paint a grey or dark iridescent body; that is Japanese Wood Pigeon (Columba janthina) or a feral pigeon.
Do not paint a yellow or green belly; the belly and flanks are white.
Do not give the female the purple shoulder patch.
Do not paint a red or black bill.
